title: Upcoming changes to AWS serverless networking charges
body:
**Beginning on or after January 1, 2027, Databricks will begin charging for hourly private endpoint usage** when serverless compute connects to your resources through private connectivity, such as AWS PrivateLink. These cloud costs have previously been covered by Databricks.

All other AWS serverless networking charges, including per-GB private connectivity, public connectivity, and cross-region/internet egress, will continue to be billed as before.

**No action is required.** Your existing networking configurations and connectivity will remain unchanged, and no charges will be applied retroactively.

Detailed pricing information, as well as a FAQ, can be found [here](https://www.databricks.com/product/pricing/data-transfer-connectivity).
